basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Residential Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps (direct final rule), 82 FR 1786, January 6, 2017
basis.label: TABLE IV–16—AVERAGE LIFETIME BY REGION: Central Air Conditioners, National 21.2 (North 24.1, Hot-humid 18.0, Hot-dry 24.9)
basis.note: Printed page 1819. Residential central air conditioners (<65,000 Btu/h), product class group covering split-system and single-package units; mapped to condensing-unit because split-system ACs (outdoor condensing unit + indoor coil) are the bulk of the class and Table V-2 (p.47, printed 1832) gives the same regional lifetimes for split-system central air conditioners. Value is for the whole split system, not the outdoor unit alone. National value used; regional range 18.0 (hot-humid) to 24.9 (hot-dry). Commercial split condensing units >=65,000 Btu/h not covered.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
